title: From Financial Barriers to Global Academic Excellence
subtitle: A Journey Towards Higher Education Through the National Overseas Scholarship
body_text: The journey of 24-year-old student, Mr. Rahul Dabhade (Name Changed) reflects how access to quality higher education and targeted financial assistance empower talented students from Scheduled Caste communities to overcome economic barriers and pursue their aspirations at prestigious international institutions. Through the National Overseas Scholarship, the Government of India continues to promote educational empowerment, equal opportunities and inclusive development, enabling deserving students to contribute to the nation's progress through their knowledge, skills and expertise. Mr. Rahul Dabhade, belonging to the Scheduled Caste community from Maharashtra, demonstrated remarkable academic dedication and determination in pursuing his higher education aspirations. Despite financial and social challenges, he remained committed to advancing his academic journey and building a promising professional career. Aspiring to pursue postgraduate studies in Construction Economics and Management at a globally reputed institution, he faced significant financial constraints due to the high cost of international education, including tuition fees, living expenses, travel and other academic requirements. A significant opportunity came in 2025–26 when he received financial assistance under the National Overseas Scholarship (NOS) Scheme of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. The scheme enabled him to pursue his MSc in Construction Economics and Management at University College London (UCL), United Kingdom, one of the leading universities in the world. The scholarship provided comprehensive financial assistance, including tuition fees amounting to £39,800, a maintenance allowance of £9,900, airfare, visa fees, insurance and other admissible academic expenses. The financial assistance under the scheme significantly reduced the economic burden associated with pursuing higher education abroad. It enabled him to continue his studies without the risk of discontinuation due to financial constraints and provided access to international academic opportunities. The support also allowed him to focus on his academic commitments and make the most of the educational facilities and learning environment at the university. With the support received through the National Overseas Scholarship, Mr. Rahul Dabhade is currently pursuing his postgraduate studies at University College London. He is actively participating in lectures, tutorials and other academic activities, gaining valuable international exposure and developing specialised knowledge in construction economics, infrastructure development and project management. The academic experience is helping him strengthen his professional competencies and broaden his understanding of global practices in the construction sector. The intervention under the National Overseas Scholarship has played an important role in overcoming financial barriers to international higher education and expanding his academic and professional opportunities. Beyond financial assistance, the scheme has enabled him to access world-class education, enhance his knowledge and work towards a promising future in his chosen field.
